name: school_staff
summary: School staff profiles layered on the reused HR employee, with teaching qualifications, substitution coverage, performance reviews and live workload/leave signals sourced from academics and HR
description: Implements the staff module from the blueprint while honouring the rule that the school reuses HR rather than duplicating it. school.staff.member is the school-side profile of a reused hr.employee record (which already links the login user and org department); a manager verifies each school.staff.qualification credential. When a teacher is away, school.staff.substitution assigns another member to cover the class referenced through the academics school.teaching.assignment, moving requested, assigned, completed or cancelled with a guard against substituting for oneself. school.staff.performance.review captures periodic classroom appraisal with a draft, submitted and approved workflow and an overall rating derived from the observation score. Workload and leave are surfaced as live computes rather than new engines: weekly teaching periods are summed from the member's active school.teaching.assignment rows and on-leave status plus open leave requests are read straight from the reused hr.leave records. Navigated under the single School app.
author: Nexa
